Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Clearwater for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from Winter Wonderland in Clearwater (opening November 28) through its final night on December 23, with the Frozen Sing-Along at the Bilheimer Capitol Theatre (November 29), the Christmas at the Aquarium movie screening (November 28 and December 4), the Holiday Parade Cruise and boat parade (December 12), Cirque Musica (December 18) and Breakfast with Santa at Clearwater Marine Aquarium (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Clearwater

  • 11 Christmas events for kids in Clearwater
  • 5 free events, including Winter Wonderland in Clearwater, the Frozen Sing-Along, the tree lighting and the boat parade
  • Meet Santa: Winter Wonderland (November 28 to December 23), Reindeer Lane (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at Clearwater Marine Aquarium (December 19) and Cookies with Santa at Moccasin Lake Nature Park (December 19, 5 to 8 pm)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Bright and Beautiful Tree Lighting (November 29), the Holiday Lighted Boat Parade and the Holiday Parade Cruise (December 12)
  • Trains: the Holiday Express train at Winter Wonderland; the Rudolph Limited is on the Largo page
  • Season: November 28 to December 23

Planning a bigger day out? Clearwater families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Tampa, which covers Busch Gardens Christmas Town, ZooTampa Lights and the Tampa Riverwalk boat parade.
